labs.location: Mossavar-Rahmani Center for Business and Government, Harvard Kennedy School, 79 John F. Kennedy Street, Cambridge, MA 02138
labs.research_summary: Joint project of the Kennedy School, Business School and Graduate School of Education that researches how schooling and training connect to jobs, aiming for better routes to economic mobility.
labs.member_breakdown: 4 faculty co-directors, 1 executive director, 3 research managers, 4 research fellows, 1 scholar in residence, 1 director of research (Skills Lab), 1 research lead (Workforce Almanac), 1 postdoctoral researcher, 2 doctoral researchers, 12 research assistants
labs.join_notes: Current and former Harvard students can apply through an online form for paid research assistant posts (HKS RA pay scale, usually 8 to 10 hours a week). A spring Future of Work study group for Harvard graduate students opens applications on December 1. The newsletter and LinkedIn page announce new openings.
labs.notes: Led by four faculty co-directors: David Deming (HKS), Joseph Fuller and Raffaella Sadun (HBS) and Peter Blair (HGSE). Kerry McKittrick is Executive Director; the contact page gives kerry_mckittrick@gse.harvard.edu for research and press inquiries. Count is from the Team page and leaves out 11 senior advisors (one emeritus) and 3 student study group leads.
